clarified_intent.description: Validate and refine controller-owned time travel, public documentation, human and runtime API ledgers, the shared fixture, security note, and assembled acceptance receipt for truthful archive readiness.

constraints: The built root and ./devtools runtime export names must equal the committed core ledger.
Documentation must describe controller ownership, complete graph capture, retention, stable expiry, rewind/live, branching, import confirmation, teardown, and compatibility exactly.
The security record must distinguish sensitive controller-local snapshot values from metadata-only serialized receipts and name rewind/import mutation authority.
Every behavioral claim must trace to the assembled packed receipt and byte-identical TypeScript/Flutter fixture.
No artifact may claim completion of downstream UI, extension, site, certification, or publication work.

target_state.description: A schema-valid deterministic QA packet with zero blocking constraint failures and exact evidence/scope traceability.
success_criteria: Built root and ./devtools runtime names equal the committed ledger.
Fixture parity plus all package, consumer, and scenario receipt fields pass.
The TypeScript and Flutter fixtures are byte-identical at the receipt SHA-256 and the packed ESM flow consumes the fixture import envelope.
README, skills reference, API table, security receipt, and verification receipt match production semantics.
Downstream DevTools and publication claims remain explicitly excluded.

unknowns: The later React and Flutter changes may extend consumption surfaces; this artifact certifies only the framework-neutral controller contract.
